## Description

R7: Orchestra skill and skill-reference text do not instruct creating a method `tdd` or `check` check-run with `runner` set to `aff`.

## Approach

Rewrite skill and reference docs (including `phase-end.md` and close-batch request examples) so `tdd`/`check` runner stamps say `orchestra`, and remove hand-typed `adaptive-artifacts create` examples that stamp `runner: "aff"`. Extend or add a skill scanner test that fails fixture text creating a `tdd`/`check` check-run with `runner: "aff"` and passes the live skills tree.
